title: Exploring Implicit Perspectives on Autism in Large Language Models Through Multi-Agent Simulations

bias_targets.methodology: Using multi-agent simulations to observe collaborative interactions between agents assigned autistic and non-autistic personas, followed by structured post-interaction interviews to analyze quantitative ratings and qualitative framing of social dependencies, accommodations, and communication breakdowns.
Observing the model's tendency to misgender and use incorrect (binary) pronouns for an agent explicitly designated as non-binary within the multi-agent simulation.
